author: Aletheia I
title: Dilated ResNet with Triple-Threat Pooling
abstract: This submission aims to capture the benefits of multiple attention pooling strategies observed in prior experiments (ID 108, 111). The model builds on the Dilated ResNet backbone and computes three parallel feature aggregations from the final sequence representation: 1) global average pooling, 2) attention pooling using a learnable CLS token as the query, and 3) attention pooling using the global average vector itself as the query. These three vectors are concatenated and passed to the prediction head. This "Triple-Threat" pooling is hypothesized to provide the most comprehensive feature set yet, combining generalist and specialist representations.

original_submission.content:
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
from jax import random
import flax.linen as nn
from typing import Dict, Any, Sequence

# --- Hyperparameters ---
def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001, 'hidden_dim': 512, 'dropout_rate': 0.1,
        'cnn_features': 256, 'cnn_kernel_size': 7, 'num_res_blocks': 3,
        'dilation_rates': [1, 2, 4], 'num_attn_heads': 4
    }

# --- Dilated Residual Block ---
class DilatedResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    features: int; kernel_size: int; dilation: int
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        y = nn.Conv(features=self.features, kernel_size=(self.kernel_size,), kernel_dilation=(self.dilation,), padding='SAME')(x)
        y = nn.relu(y); y = nn.Conv(features=self.features, kernel_size=(self.kernel_size,), kernel_dilation=(self.dilation,), padding='SAME')(y)
        if x.shape[-1] != self.features: x = nn.Conv(features=self.features, kernel_size=(1,))(x)
        return nn.relu(x + y)

# --- Main Model ---
class ResNetTriplePooling(nn.Module):
    hparams: Dict[str, Any]
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        # 1. CNN Backbone
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.hparams['cnn_features'], kernel_size=(self.hparams['cnn_kernel_size'],), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        for i in range(self.hparams['num_res_blocks']):
            dilation = self.hparams['dilation_rates'][i] if i < len(self.hparams['dilation_rates']) else self.hparams['dilation_rates'][-1]
            x = DilatedResidualBlock(features=self.hparams['cnn_features'], kernel_size=self.hparams['cnn_kernel_size'], dilation=dilation)(x)
        
        # 2. Triple Pooling Mechanism
        # 2a. Global Average Pooling
        avg_pooled = jnp.mean(x, axis=1)
        
        # 2b. Attention Pooling with CLS Token Query
        cls_token = self.param('cls_token', nn.initializers.zeros, (1, 1, self.hparams['cnn_features']))
        cls_token_batch = jnp.tile(cls_token, (x.shape[0], 1, 1))
        x_with_cls = jnp.concatenate([cls_token_batch, x], axis=1)
        cls_attn_output = nn.MultiHeadDotProductAttention(num_heads=self.hparams['num_attn_heads'], name="CLS_Attention")(
            inputs_q=x_with_cls, deterministic=deterministic)
        cls_attn_pooled = cls_attn_output[:, 0]

        # 2c. Attention Pooling with Mean Vector Query
        mean_query = avg_pooled[:, None, :]
        mean_attn_output = nn.MultiHeadDotProductAttention(num_heads=self.hparams['num_attn_heads'], name="Mean_Attention")(
            inputs_q=mean_query, inputs_kv=x, deterministic=deterministic)
        mean_attn_pooled = mean_attn_output.squeeze(axis=1)

        # 3. Fusion
        combined_features = jnp.concatenate([avg_pooled, cls_attn_pooled, mean_attn_pooled], axis=-1)

        # 4. Prediction Head
        y = nn.Dense(features=self.hparams['hidden_dim'])(combined_features)
        y = nn.relu(y); y = nn.Dropout(rate=self.hparams['dropout_rate'])(y, deterministic=deterministic)
        y = nn.Dense(features=self.hparams['d_output'])(y)
        
        if self.hparams['task_type'] == "regression": return y.squeeze(-1)
        else: return y

# --- Network Wrapper ---
class TriplePoolWrapper:
    def __init__(self, hparams): self.network = ResNetTriplePooling(hparams=hparams)
    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        params_key, dropout_key = random.split(rng_key)
        return self.network.init({'params': params_key, 'dropout': dropout_key}, dummy_input, deterministic=True)['params']
    def apply(self, params, x, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
        rngs = {}; rngs['dropout'] = rng_key if rng_key is not None else random.PRNGKey(0)
        return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=deterministic, rngs=rngs)

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]): return TriplePoolWrapper(hparams)
